name: Flame Initiate Burn Loop
summary: Chain cheap Fury casts around Flame Initiate to keep pressure up while every extra spell turns into more damage.
resultText: Repeatable burn pressure and stacked face damage
steps: Land Flame Initiate and keep at least one cheap follow-up spell available.
Use Mindstorm Bolt to clear the first blocker or go upstairs when the lane is open.
Recycle more low-cost Fury pieces to keep Flame Initiate pressure rolling.
prerequisites: A low-curve Fury shell with enough cheap spells to keep the chain alive.

name: Body Calm Stabilize Shell
summary: Stack bulky frontliners with healing support so aggro decks run out of gas before your board does.
steps: Deploy a high-HP Body unit early to clog combat.
Protect the lane with Calm healing or support effects.
Turn the stabilized board into a value snowball.
prerequisites: You want a defensive plan that converts into a longer game.
